memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the Lord gives us." So they set out from the mountain of the Lord and traveled for three days. The ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them during those three days to find them a place to rest. The cloud of the Lord was over them by day when they set out from the camp. - Num 10:32-34 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As Israel journeyed, the ark of the covenant — the symbol of God's presence — went before them "to find them a place to rest." God did not send His people ahead into the unknown alone. His presence led the way, going before them to prepare a place for them and to guide their steps.

What a comfort this is. God's people were not scouting out the wilderness by themselves, hoping to stumble upon a safe spot. The Lord Himself went ahead, searching out their resting place. Their job was simply to follow where He had already gone.

This is how God still leads His people. He goes before us. He is already in our tomorrow, preparing the way, arranging what we will need before we even arrive. We walk into the future not blindly, but following a God who has gone ahead of us.

Jesus spoke these very words of comfort to His disciples: "I am going there to prepare a place for you" (John 14:2-3). Our Lord goes before us, preparing an eternal resting place, so that where He is, we may be also. And in the daily journey too, He leads as our Good Shepherd, going ahead of His sheep (John 10:4).

Whatever unknown road lies before you, you do not walk into it alone or first. God has gone ahead. He is preparing your place of rest. Follow Him with confidence, knowing the way has already been walked by the One who leads you home.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you face the future knowing God has gone before you?
- How does it comfort you that God prepares your "place of rest"?
- Where do you need to follow God into the unknown today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You go before me, preparing the way and a place of rest. Help me to follow You into the unknown, trusting that You have gone ahead. Amen.
